data.title: 结城明日奈 · 22层木屋的暖心早餐·「快趁热吃吧，特制的三明治烤好了哦！」
data.description: 第22层湖畔木屋里，晨光把原木餐桌照得暖暖的。亚丝娜穿米白毛衣和粉色花围裙，双手稳稳托着木餐盘走向你，盘上是刚烤好的厚切三明治，热茶已经放在餐桌上。栗色侧辫垂在肩旁，她在桌边停下，先看你的表情，再露出轻快的笑。
data.location: 第22层两人购置的湖畔森林木屋厨房
data.action: 双手端木托盘送来热三明治，在原木餐桌旁停步微笑。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, breakfast tray in foreground
data.promptProse: Fresh grilled sandwiches arrive on a wooden tray held securely in both of Asuna Yuuki's hands. She has stopped beside the timber dining table in the sunny Floor 22 cabin, wearing a cream sweater and pink floral apron above a navy skirt. Her chestnut side braid rests over her shoulder as she waits for the viewer's reaction with a bright smile. A teacup is already on the table beside her. Morning light from the lake-facing window picks out the toasted bread and rising steam.
